summary: Verified the MAJOR rewrite from a sparse crossword to a CLASSIC dense fully-checked 13x13 Italian schema. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases PASS (see test_rooms.py). Create returns in <0.2s with status='generating', puzzle_ready=False; /puzzle returns 425 while generating; puzzle becomes ready in ~30-50s with rows=13, cols=13, 62 defs (31 A / 31 D), continuous numbering starting at 1, no empty clues, no answers/solution leaked to public; join, cell propagation, focus, new-puzzle (instant + background regen) all pass. Frontend E2E via Playwright on public URL: Landing 'Crea e gioca' -> navigate to /stanza/BWNE in 0.14s -> waiting screen renders share-button, big room code and 'Sto componendo il cruciverba' -> grid appears in 32.5s. Grid renders as a rectangular 13x13 CSS grid with 169 children (145 white cells + 24 black cells), no overflow, letter/number sizes scale correctly. Clue interaction: clicking clue-across-1 -> active-clue-banner shows '1 Oriz. Concederete, consegnerete in futuro'; clicking clue-down-1 switches banner to '1 Vert. Tessuto pregiato di lana fine dal decoro elegante'. Typing via hidden-input fills the selected cell. Real-time sync verified with TWO browser sessions: P2 joined via tab-unisci + code, presence shows both 'Mario' + 'Luigi', a 'Z' typed by P2 appeared on P1 within ~2s, rendered in terracotta rgb(192,92,72) as expected for player index 1.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py generate_and_store: if generation raises inside make_puzzle, it falls back to build_from_fallback which is the OLD sparse layout - this would produce a puzzle inconsistent with the new dense design. Consider retrying build_italian_crossword or making the fallback also dense.
italian_crossword.py backtracking has no hard time budget; on rare seeds it could exceed the ~60s expectation. Consider a wall-clock budget with graceful abort + retry with a new seed.
No TTL index on rooms collection; unbounded MongoDB growth.
new_puzzle endpoint does not verify caller is a player; anyone with the code can reset (acceptable for MVP).
Frontend polls every 1200ms during both waiting and playing; consider WebSocket for scale.
CrosswordGrid uses aspect-square per cell + fixed max-width; at very narrow phones (<360px) letters may become tiny but readable - not a bug, just an FYI.

Win detection was not exercised end-to-end from the UI in this run (would require filling all 145 cells with the correct solution which is not exposed). Backend win path was verified in prior iterations.
test_credentials: No auth. Ephemeral room codes generated during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Puzzle shape changed: no longer 'size' (single int); now 'rows' and 'cols' (both 13) plus 'cells' 2D array; clue numbering key is 'num' (not 'number'). Public puzzle DOES NOT include 'solution' and clues DO NOT include 'answer'. Waiting screen briefly shows 'Entro nella stanza...' loading (join call) BEFORE 'Sto componendo il cruciverba' + share-button appear - wait for share-button, not for the text. Full-solve/win overlay was not exercised in this iteration.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found; only test-file assertions needed updating to match the new 13x13 rows/cols shape and the 'num' field name.
